# tests/fixtures/nix — provenance

The Nix language grammar is **consumed, not authored** (Phase 9, the
real-world Nix adoption pass — see `.scratch/projects/011-nix-example/`).

## The grammar source (v0.3.0, verified byte-for-byte)

| file | source | version |
|---|---|---|
| `grammar.json` | `nix-community/tree-sitter-nix` `src/grammar.json` | tag **v0.3.0**, commit `ea1d87f7996be1329ef6555dcacfa63a69bd55c6` ("Release v0.3.0 (#147)", 2025-07-18) |
| `scanner.c` | `nix-community/tree-sitter-nix` `src/scanner.c` | tag **v0.3.0** (unchanged since `ef6443e`, 2023-07-08) |
| `tree_sitter/parser.h` | `nix-community/tree-sitter-nix` `src/tree_sitter/` | tag **v0.3.0** |
| `node-types.json` | **expected output** — the installed tree-sitter CLI's own generate byproduct (0.25.3) | regenerated 2026-08-05 |

- Repo: <https://github.com/nix-community/tree-sitter-nix> — MIT, maintainer
  @cstrahan, actively maintained (v0.3.0 released 2025-07-18).
- The compiled `parser.c` is NOT vendored (it is the build byproduct, not
  the source — same policy as `tests/fixtures/bash/` and
  `tests/fixtures/rust/`).

### The committed node-types.json is the supported CLI's byproduct

The committed `node-types.json` was previously generated by a NEWER CLI and
deliberately kept stale as a compatibility document. That is obsolete: the
committed file is now exactly what the supported CLI (0.25.x, pinned 0.25.3
in this repository) emits for this grammar source — `source_code` carries
`"root": true` and the `comment` extra carries `"extra": true`. It is
asserted byte-for-byte by `tests/test_community_fixtures.py` and refreshed
only through:

```bash
# Check only; exits non-zero on drift, never mutates the worktree.
devenv shell -- python tests/regenerate_community_node_types.py nix
# Intentional refresh (supported CLI 0.25.x only).
devenv shell -- python tests/regenerate_community_node_types.py --write nix
```

The schema's semantic shape (visible vs. hidden externals, the dual
`inherit` entry) is pinned toolchain-free in
`tests/test_schema.py::test_nix_node_types_shape_semantics`.

## The fleet corpus (the example corpus, not the grammar byproduct)

`fleet/` holds the seven real devenv.nix configs consumed by the
devenv-extract example; per-file provenance lives in `fleet/FLEET_PROVENANCE`
(repo + commit per file). `ground_truth.json` is the hand-written truth
(130 rows) written from nix semantics before any models; verified against
the raw file text.

## Wheel-consistency note (resolved in Run 1 of the Phase-9 kickoff)

The PyPI wheel `tree-sitter-nix` 0.1.0 (uploaded 2025-02-20) was built from
a source state where the grammar.json last changed at commit `04e5dca`
(2022-09-07) and the scanner.c at `ef6443e` (2023-07-08) — the grammar
source was **frozen between 2022-09-07 and 2025-07-16**. The only
grammar.json delta between the wheel era and v0.3.0 is the
trailing-comma-in-formals fix (`bae4c4f` "#131", 2025-07-16): v0.3.0 allows
a trailing comma WITHOUT ellipses in function formals; the wheel requires
the comma to pair with ellipses. The wheel's scanner.c is byte-identical to
v0.3.0's. So the v0.3.0-derived schema is truthful for the wheel except for
that one grammar rule — see `.scratch/projects/011-nix-example/FINDINGS.md`
for the parse-probe verdict.
